operation_details.item: Earlier, the user planned to deploy the service on GCP.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: We're finalizing the deployment plan for the service. Can you help me check the infrastructure choices?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Sure, I can review the current plan. What specifics do you want to verify?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Earlier, I planned to deploy the service on GCP.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Got it. Has that decision changed since then?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I now plan to deploy the service on AWS.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The change followed the pricing review.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. Is the new AWS target reflected in your infrastructure documentation?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The deployment target is set in the infra plan.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good. Then the infra plan should be the source of truth for provisioning.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, I'll update the configs to match it.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Do you need any help with the AWS resource definitions?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Just a quick check that the instance sizes are appropriate.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I can help with sizing if you share the workload details.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Let me gather those details and open the plan.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Fine. Once you share them, I'll review the setup.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Sounds good. I'll keep an eye out for the details.
